newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK FINMIN TO CLARIFY TAX ON STATE SECURITIES NEXT WEEK.
newsitem.headline: GREEK FINMIN TO CLARIFY TAX ON STATE SECURITIES NEXT WEEK.

text.p: Greek Deputy Finance Minister Nicos Christodoulakis told reporters on Thursday that details about the taxation of state bonds and T-bills will be announced next week.
The ministry will distribute a bulletin that will include details and specific examples on how government debt paper will be taxed, said Christodoulakis.
The ministry would feed information to Reuters and other news agencies to let everybody in the market know at the same time about policy changes, he said.

A late decision by the finance ministry to notify banks that they would be entitled to a selling commission of 0.45 percent if they bid at the auction of 12-month T-bills on February 3 caused havoc prompting some banks to cry foul play. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
